title: Finite localized restriction maps detect boundary sections
statement: Let L be a locally Noetherian scheme, U an open, N a quasi-coherent module, V an affine open, and p a prime of R=O(V) whose point is outside U. For any submodule S of (j_*(N|U))(V), there exist finitely many R_p-modules Q_i, scalars a_i in the maximal ideal of R_p, and R_p-linear maps phi_i:S_p -> Q_i, such that multiplication by a_i is injective on Q_i and all phi_i(z)=0 implies z=0. The family may be empty.

proof.text: Choose finitely many basic opens D(f_i) covering U intersect V. Every f_i lies in p since the point of p is outside U. Quasi-coherence of restriction and qcqs pushforward identifies sections on these opens with P[1/f_i]. Sheaf separatedness on U intersect V makes the restriction map from P to the finite product injective.

Localize the finite-product injection at p and compose with the localized inclusion S -> P. These remain injective. Set Q_i=(P[1/f_i])_p and a_i=image(f_i) in the maximal ideal. Each a_i acts invertibly on Q_i. The component maps phi_i detect zero. For an empty cover, sheaf separatedness gives P=0 and hence S_p=0.

lean.statement:
theorem boundary_localized_finite_detector
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens) (N : L.Modules)
    (hqc : N.IsQuasicoherent) (V : L.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (S : Submodule (L.presheaf.obj (op V))
      (((Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj
        ((Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N)).val.obj (op V)))
    (p : Ideal (L.presheaf.obj (op V))) [p.IsPrime]
    (hy : hV.fromSpec ⟨p, inferInstance⟩ ∉ U) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (Q : Fin n → ModuleCat.{u} (Localization.AtPrime p))
      (a : Fin n → IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p))
      (φ : (i : Fin n) → LocalizedModule.AtPrime p S →ₗ[Localization.AtPrime p] Q i),
      (∀ i, Function.Injective (fun x : Q i ↦ (a i : Localization.AtPrime p) • x)) ∧
      (∀ z, (∀ i, φ i z = 0) → z = 0)
